findings.tariffChannel: native Sagelio-managed charging point; exact price must be read for the selected point/session
positiveEvidence: Sagelio official 2026 guidance to host businesses explains that the retail charging tariff is set according to the individual site's energy cost and economics.
The same first-party guidance explicitly states that there is no tariff valid for every installation/context and uses 0.59 EUR/kWh only as a worked example, not a network tariff.
negativePaths: Do not promote the 0.59 EUR/kWh example as a Sagelio network-wide price.
Do not infer a tariff from Sagelio business-model examples or host energy cost.
Third-party eMSP prices remain discovery/corroboration only unless mapped to direct CPO pricing.
findings.blockage: exact direct tariff varies by host/site and is not exposed as one nationwide deterministic grid
findings.resumeCondition: map IT*SAG EVSE to Sagelio/native point payload or QR/session tariff; preserve energy/start/time/parking components and fail-close unmatched EVSE

findings.tariffModel: native station/EVSE direct tariff exposed by Allego station pages; national speed grid retained only as corroboration
positiveEvidence: Official Allego Milano station page exposes direct DC price 0.805 EUR/kWh and four exact ITALLEGO EVSE identifiers, all up to 300 kW.
Official Allego station pages therefore provide a stronger deterministic station/EVSE-to-price path than inferring each EVSE from national speed classes.
Existing repository script scripts/allego_station_tariffs.py already implements the same station-page plus app.allego.eu/price/<EVSE> exact-price method for France and can be adapted to Italy.
negativePaths: Do not round or transpose the national displayed speed-band price onto an EVSE when its official station page exposes an exact direct value.
Do not classify all 28 EVSE from one known 300 kW site.
findings.blockage: the eight current Italian inventory stations must be exhaustively joined to official Allego station pages/EVSE price endpoints before ALL can become treated
findings.resumeCondition: adapt/run the existing Allego exact station tariff collector for Italy, join all 28 inventory EVSE, preserve exact per-station/per-EVSE direct prices and fees, fail-close unmatched EVSE
